scope: apps/api connected to a Supabase-hosted PostgreSQL instance (Session pooler) and its 10 existing Prisma migrations applied; no AWS resource touched, no code change required

connection.credential_handling: DATABASE_URL set directly into the operator's local .env by the operator; never pasted into chat, never printed by any command run here, not committed.

local_environment_obstacle.problem: Running `prisma migrate deploy` directly on this NixOS dev machine fails: Prisma's CLI tries to download a prebuilt schema-engine binary for a 'linux-nixos' target that does not exist upstream (404), and a nix-store prisma-engines package found locally (6.18.0) is a different major version than the installed Prisma CLI (7.10.1), which produces a JSON-RPC parse error when forced.
local_environment_obstacle.pre_existing: Same root cause already observed and recorded while verifying the Vercel fix (root `pnpm build` failing at apps/api prebuild for the same reason); unrelated to Supabase and unrelated to this task's correctness.
local_environment_obstacle.workaround_used: Built the `migrate` target from infrastructure/Dockerfile (base image node:24-bookworm-slim, a normal Debian target Prisma ships real binaries for) and ran it once with `docker run --env-file .env <image>`, overriding its compose-time DATABASE_URL with the operator's local .env. This reuses the exact migration path infrastructure/docker-compose.staging.yml already uses for CD, just pointed at Supabase instead of the staging Postgres container.

steps.step: docker run --rm --env-file .env --entrypoint sh tixflow-migrate-supabase -c "pnpm exec prisma migrate status"
steps.output: Database schema is up to date!

not_covered_by_this_task: Seeding demo data (pnpm db:seed) — not run; Supabase instance currently has schema only, no rows
Pointing a running apps/api instance at this DATABASE_URL and smoke-testing a real request end-to-end — the Docker build above only ran the one-shot migrate entrypoint, not the api service itself
Updating the deployment secret store (vs. the operator's local .env) for any environment beyond this machine
Supabase Free-tier auto-pause behavior (7 days no traffic) was not exercised or timed in this session; recorded as a known limitation in CR-20261114-004, not re-verified here
